name: threejs-animation
title_zh: 让 Three.js 对象按你的剧本动起来
tagline_zh: GLTF 动画不会播？关键帧手写到吐？骨骼、形变、混合，一句指令就编排好，还能叠加出自然过渡。
tagline_en: Stuck with GLTF animations that won't play? Keyframes written by hand? Bones, morphs, blends—one command to.
desc_en: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.
why_zh: 它把动画状态机抽象成自然语言指令，自动处理骨骼/形变/关键帧的底层同步，你只管说『让角色从走到跑』。
why_en: It abstracts the animation state machine into natural-language commands, auto-syncing bones, morphs, and keyframes—you just say.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 运行时动画编排，不生成模型、不处理材质贴图、不导出文件；骨骼动画需模型自带蒙皮数据。
limit_en: Runtime animation only—no model generation, textures, or file export. Skeletal animation requires rigged models; otherwise falls back to keyframes.
